messages:
incident-bot: 🔔 PagerDuty alert triggered: Possible cross-tenant routing / KV-prefix exposure detected in Dedicated pool `ded-lyra-prod` (severity: P1). Brief: requests logged with tenant_id `lyra` showing traces where responses contained payloads referencing tenant_id `mira` — potential cross-read. Pager: @oncall-alex

oncall-alex: On it. Paging SRE. Can someone pull the latest routing table + kv-cache lookup logs?

sre-maya: grabbing logs now. preliminary: I see matcher hits where prefix `cust:mira:` was looked up on nodes serving `lyra`-pinned sessions. Not yet sure if this is read-after-write or stale cache.

eng-lee: FYI I deployed a routing tweak yesterday that expanded fallback matches for model variants — could be related. Pasting the routing policy query from the runtime:

```
# runtime routing decide
policy="tenant-aware-strict-fallback"
match: incoming_prefix=\"cust:lyra:\"
candidates: [primary(lyra-pool), fallback(shared-read-only)]
kv_lookup(cluster=kv-prod, key=\"cust:mira:session:123\") // <-- suspicious
```

support-ana: Customer impact: Lyra reports 2 users saw content that referenced another company name. They've escalated to security. Currently front-end is showing partial PII-like strings.

lyra-security: Confirmed. We captured screenshots and sanitized payloads. We're seeing the other tenant name in a model response. Need containment now.

oncall-alex: Immediate mitigation steps I propose: 1) Remove `shared-read-only` fallback for lyra routing (hotfix), 2) Evict long-lived sessions on nodes in `ded-lyra-prod` that have cross-tenant cache hits, 3) Disable KV prefix caching globally for 15m while we validate. Who can push the routing blacklist?

eng-lee: I can flip the runtime flag to disable shared fallback for lyra. Pushing config now.

incident-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollout of config `runtime-routing-v2026.03.15-lyra-hotfix` to pool `ded-lyra-prod`.

eng-lee: Rollout started. Command used:
```
redwoodctl config set routing.override.ded-lyra-prod.fallback=false --meta=inc-4021
redwoodctl rollout start runtime-routing-v2026.03.15-lyra-hotfix --pool=ded-lyra-prod
```

sre-maya: While that's rolling, I'm collecting KV access traces. Sample of suspicious trace (redacted):
```
[2026-03-15T14:10:12Z] node=gpu-12 ded_pool=ded-lyra-prod session=abc123 tenant_in=lyra request_id=req-9a7
kv.get(key="cust:mira:prompt-cache:7f4c") -> hit (node-local)
response.tokens: ... "Hello Mira team" ...
```

support-ana: That's a smoking gun if kv.get served a mira key on lyra node.

eng-lee: Rollout shows 60% of traffic switched; fallback disabled for lyra in runtime. Monitoring for further cross-tenant hits.

incident-bot: monitor-bot: Alert: KV cache hit-rate for cross-tenant keys dropped ~95% after config change.

lyra-security: Confirming: no new instances of the other tenant in responses after ~3 minutes post-change. Thank you.

oncall-alex: Good. Next: evict any node-local KV entries that may have invalid tenant mapping, and rotate per-pool routing caches. Maya, can you run the eviction and gather checksums?

sre-maya: Running eviction on nodes:
```
for node in $(redwoodctl pool nodes ded-lyra-prod);
  do ssh $node "redwood-kvctl evict --prefix 'cust:' --filter 'other-tenant'";
done
```
Outputs:
```
node gpu-12: evicted 12 keys
node gpu-13: evicted 8 keys
node gpu-14: evicted 0 keys
```

eng-lee: Also invalidated runtime routing cache: `redwoodctl runtime cache flush --pool=ded-lyra-prod --type=routing,kv`

support-ana: Customer update sent: "We've isolated the issue, applying mitigations now. We'll follow up with root-cause and next steps." Lyra asked for a preservation of evidence. Who owns that?

pm-jordan: We'll own the customer comms thread and PR to legal. SRE: capture full traces and store in secured evidence bucket. Note ticket INC-4021.

sre-maya: Evidence archived to s3://inc-4021-evidence/ with access restricted. Saved request traces, node metadata, and rollout diffs.

lyra-security: We appreciate the quick containment. Two asks: (1) timeline of affected requests, (2) assurance that no persisted storage or backups contain cross-tenant data.

eng-lee: Timeline: first anomalous trace at 2026-03-15T14:09:58Z, containment started 14:12Z, fallback disabled 14:13Z, cache eviction completed 14:18Z.

sre-maya: For backups: kv snapshots are sharded by tenant prefix and we run daily snapshots. I'll run a targeted scan for any `cust:mira:` keys stored in lyra shard ranges and report.

incident-bot: scan-bot: Starting `kv-shard-scan` for pool `ded-lyra-prod` - estimated 12m.

support-ana: Internal severity update: downgraded from P1->P2 for platform ops. Customer still sees high severity.

oncall-alex: Good. Follow ups: - eng to review the fallback expansion that allowed cross-tenant lookups - SRE to add tenant-strict validation on KV access paths - product/security to coordinate outreach + offer audit. Assigning owners: eng-lee (code fix), sre-maya (hardening + alerts), pm-jordan (customer comms), support-ana (postmortem comm).

eng-lee: I'll open PR to tighten fallback heuristic: require tenant header match before falling back to shared caches. PR: github.com/redwood/runtime/pull/5821. Tests include simulated lease collisions.

sre-maya: Will add an alert rule: any KV hit where key.tenant != session.tenant triggers immediate P0 paging and auto-blacklist of that node.

lyra-security: Please also provide attestations of key rotation/retention policies once scan completes. We may request a brief call with legal.

pm-jordan: Noted. Setting up a 1:1 with Lyra sec + legal for 16:30 UTC.

incident-bot: incident-closed: Initial containment complete. Creating follow-up task list under INC-4021.

support-ana: Drafting customer remediation offer: free audit window + 3 months elevated logging retention. Sending draft to pm-jordan for review.

eng-lee: After we merge the PR, I'll schedule canary rollout to 5% of pools tomorrow, then 100% next week.

sre-maya: Scan results (completed): no persisted cross-tenant keys found in snapshots older than 7d. All evicted keys were node-local caches. Will attach report to INC-4021.

lyra-security: Thank you for the transparency and speed. We'll wait for the formal postmortem and the timeline.

oncall-alex: Great work team. Lessons: avoid permissive fallback, strengthen tenant-binding checks at routing and KV layers, and add automated eviction/blacklist on tenant-mismatch. Closing thread for live operations; keep INC-4021 open for postmortem. :white_check_mark:
